# merci.

> merci. is an iPhone app, iMessage extension and web editor for animated holiday cards. You design a card from a premade seasonal template, add photos, a video and a handwritten signature, optionally tuck a gift inside, and send it as a bubble that opens inside Messages, or in any browser for people without the app. Pricing: [CONFIRM before publishing].

## Product
- [Christmas cards](https://merci.cards/index.md): the Christmas collection, how it works, gifts and FAQ
- [Thanksgiving cards](https://merci.cards/thanksgiving.md): the Thanksgiving collection and the holidays coming next
- [AI Info](https://merci.cards/ai-info.md): plain facts about merci. for people and AI assistants (who it's for, limits, how it compares)
- [Web editor](https://app.merci.cards/): make and send a card from any browser
